mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, PRESET_TYPE AS presetType, FILTER_JSON AS filterJson, TO_CHAR(REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regDt, TO_CHAR(UPD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updDt FROM TB_USER_FILTER_PRESET WHERE USER_ID = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PRESET_TYPE = #{presetType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_USER_FILTER_PRESET T USING ( SELECT #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS USER_ID, #{presetType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS PRESET_TYPE, #{filterJson,jdbcType=CLOB} AS FILTER_JSON FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.USER_ID = S.USER_ID AND T.PRESET_TYPE = S.PRESET_TYPE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.FILTER_JSON = S.FILTER_JSON, T.UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_ID, PRESET_TYPE, FILTER_JSON, REG_DT, UPD_DT) VALUES (S.USER_ID, S.PRESET_TYPE, S.FILTER_JSON, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
